risk_assessment.chain_of_thought_reasoning:

2. HYDRAULIC & RIVERINE STAGE: River Kolkata River Drainage Basin has BREACHED the official Danger Level (53.50 m) at 57.860 m (buffer: +4.360 m). Rate of rise is surging at +0.000 m/h.
3. TOPOGRAPHIC RUNOFF BEHAVIOR: Catchment terrain has low permeability (Loam, runoff coefficient 0.55, TWI 16.8), accelerating overland surge directly into drainage networks (choke ratio: 62%).
4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (0.380) and SAR radar (-18.2 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.950 with 90.2% sensor certainty. Conclusion: CRITICAL FLOOD DISASTER CONFIRMED along River Kolkata River Drainage Basin in Kolkata district.

decision_and_early_warning.public_broadcast_sms: [URGENT ROUTE DIVERSION - RED ALERT] Primary Evacuation Camp (Kolkata Central Flood Relief Camp & High School Ground) is INUNDATED by expanding floodwaters! DO NOT PROCEED TOWARDS LOWLANDS. All evacuees must IMMEDIATELY DIVERT to Alternative High-Ground Safe Haven: Jadavpur University Main Campus & High-Ground Auditoriums (Tier-1 Elevated Academic & Civic Sanctuary, Distance: 8.24 km). Move to high ground immediately!

recommended_tactical_actions.action: Seal off inundated Primary Camp access road. Direct all citizen evacuation convoys along elevated bypass routes to Jadavpur University Main Campus & High-Ground Auditoriums.
Deploy 4 NDRF battalions & SDRF motorized rescue boats to Kolkata River Drainage Basin Low-lying Embankments, Kolkata Central Sluice Gate Basin.
Full closure of Kolkata River Drainage Basin outfall sluice gates to prevent backflow into Kolkata municipal storm channels.
Activate all auxiliary heavy dewatering diesel pumps (5000 gpm); shut down inundated electrical transformers.
Enforce traffic diversions across arterial bridges and secure elevated evacuation corridors to district relief shelters.
Establish mobile medical clinics, potable water tankers, and dry ration distribution in designated cyclone/flood shelters.
